svg.title: Ankush — Machine Learning & Software Engineering
svg.desc: Animated banner. A git commit graph builds itself: init, train: fine-tune VLMs and LLMs, ci: signed reproducible builds, feat: event-driven backend, infra: kubernetes + terraform, serve: models behind vLLM, merged into main. A typed line cycles through skills and tools.
